name: Push-Up Plus
steps: Assume a standard high-plank position on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and your core and glutes braced.
Bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your torso to lower your chest smoothly toward the floor.
Press back up to full elbow extension, then push even further into the floor to spread your shoulder blades apart and gently round your upper back.
Allow your shoulder blades to settle smoothly back to neutral before lowering into the next repetition.
tips: Make sure the extra reach at the top comes from protracting your shoulder blades rather than shrugging toward your ears or sagging your hips.
Maintain straight arms throughout the final push-plus motion.
